game.title: Duke Nukem Forever
game.blurb: First-person shooter from Gearbox Software and 3D Realms (RAWG also lists Piranha Games and Triptych Games), published by 2K Games and Aspyr, released 2011-06-09. RAWG average playtime: 3 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters follow the campaign bosses and places named in the Steam achievements, plus chapters drawn from achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Campaign and its Bosses
chapters.summary: The bosses named in the achievements, in order of unlock rate: the Cycloid, the Battlelord in Las Vegas, the Alien Queen, the Battlelord on the Hoover Dam, the Octaking and the Energy Leech, then the credits. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Strip Club, Stadium and Other Set Pieces
chapters.summary: Air hockey, beers and Alien Abortion in the strip club, the blimp above the stadium, the talk show, the Forkstop secret closet and the catfish in the underwater level.

chapters.title: Ego Boosts and Secrets
chapters.summary: Ego cap rewards, the three helmets, phone messages, the gold pistol, the calendar, the whiteboard, pinball and other things to find.

chapters.title: Difficulty Runs
chapters.summary: Finishing the campaign on Easy, Normal, Hard and Insane.

chapters.title: Vehicles, Gadgets and Power-ups
chapters.summary: The monster truck, the forklift, Trip Mines, the Holoduke, alien fighters and gunships, beer, steroids and food.

chapters.title: Combat
chapters.summary: Kill counts, stomps, executions, headshots, frozen aliens, explosives, thrown objects and taking hits.

chapters.title: Downloadable Content
chapters.summary: Twelve hidden achievements whose API names point to extra content, such as a moon buggy, a science pinball score, Dr. Proton and a second set of difficulty clears. Spoiler-guarded.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 57900)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Duke_Nukem_Forever
Fandom (dukenukem.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://dukenukem.fandom.com/wiki/Duke_Nukem_Forever
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 4483). The Steam store list has one matching app, 57900 ("Duke Nukem Forever"); its schema is named "Untitled Piranha Game" (an internal placeholder name). StrategyWiki has "Duke Nukem Forever" at completion stage 1, but of its many subpages only Achievements and trophies (about 8,200 characters), Controls (about 2,800), Weapons (about 1,700), Enemies (about 1,400), Cheats (about 1,200), the first level "Duke Lives" (about 2,100) and Table of Contents are written; Walkthrough, Gameplay, Ego Boosts, Voicemails and the other level pages from "Damn! It's Late" to "Duke Side of the Moon" are linked but not written, so it was not used. dukenukem.fandom.com answers the API under "Duke Nukem Forever" with about 165 linked articles (levels, weapons, enemies and versions); names only were looked at, nothing copied. 12 of 62 Steam achievements are hidden, all at the end of the schema. Their API names include ACH_MoonBuggyKills, ACH_SciencePinballScore, ACH_DefeatDrProton and ACH_EasyCompletedDLC03 to ACH_ExpertCompletedDLC03, so they get a DLC chapter instead of the story chapter. RAWG keeps one DLC entry, "Duke Nukem Forever: The Doctor Who Cloned Me" (2011-12-13), and StrategyWiki and Fandom both have a page of that name; that these hidden achievements belong to it is a guess, so the chapter title stays neutral. The boss order is our own reading of the unlock rates (89.1% for the Cycloid down to 23.1% for the Energy Leech). No Steam achievement covers multiplayer, so there is no multiplayer chapter.
